tenderSchedule.description: Supply of Ayurveda and Unani Medicines for District Ayush Office Ramanagara 2026-27
tenderSchedule.remarks: District Ayush Office, Room No.208, 2nd Floor, Zilla panchayath Bhavana, B.M Road, Bangalore South District, Ramanagara.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Authority Letter from the Competent Authority for authorized signatory.
Copy of Letter of Undertaking as per Annexure-B.
Drug Manufacturing License with date of validity.
Document regarding office/branch having registered office in Karnataka.
Submission of a valid Udyam Registration certificate bearing an address in the state of Karnataka in mandatory.
Non-conviction Certificate for 2023, 2024 and 2025 years from the Drug Licensing Authority of the State in Form 26 E3 of Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940
An affidavit stating that the license of the company has not been cancelled in the past or that it has not been barred from manufacture of the supplied products.
Copy of GST registration Certificate and September-2026 months GST Returns

Authorized distributers should submit manufacturer detailed installed capacity for one month or one year as per Annexure-D OR Company/Authorized Firm should submit detailed installed capacity for one month or one year as per Annexure-D
Performance certificate as per Annexure H
Dealership or agreement document copy with manufacturing company (Only for authorized distributors)
Trade license certificate (Only for authorized distributors)
As per Annexure C (Medicine list) Sample Should be submitted in Annexure-J
Copies of the PAN Card of the entity, Income Tax Returns for 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 Financial years.
Copy of Audited financial annual turnover statement. Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheets for two financial years duly certified by Chartered Accountant (2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26).
General and Financial information and Declaration duly filled as per Annexure-E.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All other required document has to be uploaded as per tender document
